style: Flat 2D storybook illustration, bold simplified shapes with clean edges, soft cel shading, subtle paper grain. Warm palette of ochre, terracotta and sand with deep teal shadows, strong warm rim light. Vertical composition with the main subject in the upper two thirds. No text, no letters, no watermark, no border.

shots.prompt: An empty, quiet stretch of dark teal river at dusk seen from above, framed only by tall reeds. In the centre a small thumb-sized carved stone cylinder is sinking below the surface, half under water, with a ring of ripples and a few bubbles around it. Only water, reeds and the small stone fill the frame.

Inside an ancient Mesopotamian mudbrick storehouse around 3100 BC, a worried administrator with a shaved head, bare chest and a knee-length wrapped wool skirt stands barefoot between towering heaps of golden barley and rows of big clay jars, both hands on his head, overwhelmed. A shaft of sunlight falls from a small square opening high in the wall, dust in the air. Medium shot.

Macro close-up filling the whole frame with soft wet tan clay. Two fingers hold a thin cut reed stalk like a pen and press its round end straight down into the clay, making a neat row of deep circular holes: three finished holes and a fourth being pressed. Hard grazing light from the left, deep shadows inside each hole. Only the fingertips, the reed and the clay are visible.

Top-down close-up of one hand pressing and rolling a short thumb-sized stone cylinder, like a thick bead, along the surface of a palm-sized slab of wet clay that lies on a woven reed mat. In the clay behind the cylinder there is a shallow embossed band in the same clay colour showing a tiny man, two dogs and two boars, pressed into the tablet surface itself. Strong raking light from the left makes the embossed figures cast small shadows.

Close-up of a single open empty hand, palm up, filling the middle of the frame, lit from above by a narrow warm beam of light. A few glowing dust motes drift just above the empty palm. Plain deep teal background with nothing else in it. Quiet, still.
